# Inside / Outside

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Features split by whether they touch any feature of a second table (a point inside a polygon, on its edge included, as turf.booleanPointInPolygon): `inside` and `outside`.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "inside", "name": "inside", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "inside"`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `in` | `table` | one edge |
| `polygons` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->
This operator has no parameters.
<!-- gen:end params -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Port | Type |
